versions.changelog:
fix optimize scoring: use the league's own categories and rate stats
cmd_optimize reused _compute_standout_score -- a single-day composite with
fixed weights -- against season cumulative totals. Three problems followed:

- Volume bias. Every term was a counting stat, so the score tracked
  accumulated playing time rather than quality. Acuna (393 AB) scored 472.1
  against Reynolds (581 AB) at 591.1 and was recommended for the bench,
  despite beating him on per-game rates and over the last month
  (7 HR/20 RBI/.414 OBP vs 2 HR/5 RBI/.333).
- OBP was numerically dead: obp*3 on .325 is 0.98 points out of 543, under
  0.2% of a score, for one of five batting categories.
- Hits carried 25% of the score although neither H nor AVG is a category
  in this league. The weights never consulted the league at all.

Add _score_pool(), which derives weights from league.stat_categories(),
min-max normalizes each category across the pool and averages them, so
every scoring category carries equal weight and unscored stats contribute
nothing. Batters and pitchers normalize in separate pools; ERA/WHIP/BB9
invert. Baseline values come from Yahoo's average_season window (already
per-game) blended with lastmonth form at _RECENCY_WEIGHT, so playing time
cannot inflate a score. Under 15 AB / 5 IP in the recent window falls back
to the season rate rather than punishing a small sample. Scores are 0-100.
Falls back to the legacy formula if categories can't be read.

_compute_standout_score is untouched and still backs the standouts command,
where a single-day composite is the right tool. CLAUDE.md now documents why
the two paths must stay separate.

Pitchers: a starter-only arm who is not today's probable starter now scores
0 -- his team having a game is irrelevant because he will not take the
mound. Previously "team is playing" was enough, which produced swaps of one
idle SP for another. At priority 0 the incumbent now keeps the slot instead
of being displaced by an idle arm with better season numbers.

Also stop emitting swap groups that never touch the bench. This reverts the
filter from 4cd4121, which surfaced pure active-to-active reshuffles so the
solver's assignment would not vanish from output. The symptom was real, but
such a move leaves the same set of players in the lineup and so cannot change
category production -- it is unactionable churn (UTIL -> SS and the like).
Reshuffle legs are still reported when they are part of a genuine bench swap,
e.g. a UTIL player sliding to 1B to make room for an incoming bat.

# yahoo-fantasy-baseball 0.1.18

- Documentation updated in SKILL.md for clearer usage and command instructions.
- No user-facing feature or API changes.

- Added improved error handling and output formatting.
- Refactored internal scripts for better maintainability.
- Updated dependencies in requirements.txt.
- Minor documentation updates and clarifications in SKILL.md.

- This release makes the skill entirely read-only — roster changes and modifications are no longer supported.
- Updated description and documentation to clarify the skill now only provides data queries, lineup analysis, and suggestions.
- Installation process now highlights the use of the `--setup` command and provides more specific environment variable requirements.
- Write operations (add, drop, swap, claim, etc.) have been removed from both the usage documentation and feature set.
- All optimization and management features now deliver suggestions only, without making actual roster changes.
- optimize shouldn't recommend position to position swaps, only those from/to the bench.
- don't include locked players in swap decisions.
Additional optimization fixes, be aware of games in progress or completed (locked), be more clear about multi-move replacements.
- off and scratched players shouldn't be considered for swaps in optimize.
- added lineup-check command and optimize updated to consider whether player is in the lineup

- fixed bug in optimize (not considering valid position).
- consider preseason stats when ranking available players for optimize, early in the season.
Additional optimize enhancements.
- improvements to the optimize command.

Version 0.1.7

- Added `standouts` command to show yesterday's top performers and notable bench stats for all league teams.
- Updated documentation to detail the new `standouts` feature and usage examples.

Version 0.1.6

- Added support for filtering transactions by date range using the `--since` flag in the `transactions` command.
- Updated documentation to include the new `--since 3d` usage example.
- fixed scoreboard
Add game time to roster (day) output.

- Improved MLB team/player name matching for schedule lookups, handling edge cases like special characters and alternate abbreviations.
- Refined status formatting for daily roster and schedule commands to reduce false "off day" flags and increase accuracy.
- Various minor fixes for robust handling of team names and abbreviations across MLB data sources.
- Updated documentation to reflect improved handling of MLB player name edge cases and to clarify common flags.

- Added a new `day` command to view roster status for a specific date (`--date YYYY-MM-DD`).
- Documented `day` in the Quick Start and Daily Management sections; clarified that `today` is a shortcut for `day` using today's date.
- Roster status output now shows all eligible positions for each player when using `day` or `today`.
- Updated command documentation in SKILL.md for consistency and to reflect new features.

- Updated all example commands to use the absolute path prefix (`python3 /home/claw/.openclaw/workspace/skills/yahoo-fantasy-baseball/yahoo-fantasy-baseball.py`) instead of just `python`.
- No changes to functionality or features; documentation only.

- Updated the description of the `--sort` flag in the SKILL.md for clarity, specifying sort order meanings and labeling "OR" as the default.
- No changes to features, logic, or interface; documentation update only.

Initial release of Yahoo Fantasy Baseball skill.  
- Manage Yahoo Fantasy Baseball teams with roster, standings, matchup, draft, transaction, and injury views.
- Daily roster optimization suggests lineup swaps, IL moves, and pitching adjustments.
- Execute team management: swap positions, add/drop, move to IL, and submit waiver claims with preview/confirmation.
- Auto-installs dependencies and streamlines Yahoo OAuth authentication.
- Flexible command-line tools for data queries and team actions with multiple output formats.
